doc.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012

title: Mitch Miller's family on Elmira Street
summary: Mitch Miller's family lived on the street near the grocery store; his mother still lived there.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Right. Interestingly enough, the street that we lived on is called Martin Street. And a block up from where my father’s grocery store, was a street called Elmira Street. And on Elmira Street was Mitch Miller. And his family lived there. And he of course, by the time
I was around to any extent he had become successful and moved away, but his mother was still there.
Oh yeah. And I’m pretty sure a sibling or two lived in Rochester. I’m not sure that they were, but his mother was there.
